delivery_jobs_seen.verdict: CANDIDATE: 9.00 ISK per Scordite delivered is above the ~5-8 ISK buy orders seen for Scordite; budget/cap not shown on the page. Compare with the sell price each time (not yet automatic).

rule: Freelance mining jobs ADD to the ore's market value (the ore stays yours). Delivery jobs only help when they pay above the best buy order. '90%Jita' jobs pay 10% under Jita value: never better than selling to buy orders.
